name: High Memory Usage
message_template: {app} has been using high memory ({value}%) for an extended period.
suggestion: Consider closing unused tabs or restarting the application to free up memory.

name: High CPU Consumption
message_template: {app} has been consuming high CPU ({value}%) for over {duration}.
suggestion: Review active tasks or background processes within this application.

name: Zombie Process Alert
message_template: Zombie process detected: {app} (PID {pid}) is defunct and cannot be reclaimed by its parent.
suggestion: Inspect parent process health or terminate the parent process to clean up zombie slots.
